units.source_text: 当她急于重整化妆时，镜子最能映现出夫人那喜爱高谈阔论的开朗女子的形象。

en.t: When she was hurriedly trying to fix her makeup, the mirror most clearly reflected the image of the lady as a cheerful woman who loved grand, lively conversation.

units.source_text: 夫人回到会客间来，不大一会儿，小姐递过来一张男子的名片。

en.t: The lady returned to the reception room, and before long the young woman handed her a man's calling card.
